test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. No art is a drawing.

II. Some drawings are paintings.

III. All sketches are paintings.

**Conclusions:**

I. No sketch is a drawing.

II. No painting is an art.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2df17d969a5c341bb694a52d623371aa568ac643e0386d148f2d4b21b08bf2fb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No sketch is a drawing → Does not follow (As some drawings are paintings and all sketches are paintings. As no direct relation is given between sketches and drawings, therefore it is false.)

II. No painting is an art → Does not follow (As no art is a drawing and some drawings are paintings. As no direct relation is given between art and paintings, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
